description: Initialize monorepo with Turborepo, set up all workspace packages (apps/web, apps/api, packages/database, packages/shared), configure TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier, and establish the project foundation including Prisma schema with full database models.
steps: Create root package.json with pnpm workspaces config pointing to apps/* and packages/*
Create turbo.json with build/test/lint pipeline configuration
Create root tsconfig.json as base TypeScript config with strict mode
Create root .eslintrc.js and .prettierrc for shared linting/formatting
Create .gitignore with node_modules, .next, dist, .env, prisma generated client
Create .env.example with all needed environment variables (DATABASE_URL, OPENAI_API_KEY, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL, REDIS_URL)

Initialize apps/web as Next.js 14 app with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, App Router - create package.json, next.config.js, tsconfig.json, tailwind.config.ts, postcss.config.js, src/app/layout.tsx with root providers, src/app/page.tsx as landing redirect
Initialize apps/api as NestJS application - create package.json, tsconfig.json, nest-cli.json, src/main.ts with NestFactory bootstrap, src/app.module.ts, src/app.controller.ts, src/app.service.ts

Initialize packages/database with Prisma - create package.json, tsconfig.json, prisma/schema.prisma with comprehensive schema (User, Team, TeamMember, Project, Crawl, Page, Keyword, KeywordCluster, Content, TopicalMap, TopicalMapNode, Backlink, Ranking, Report, AiTask, Subscription, Audit, AuditIssue models with proper relations, enums, indexes)

Initialize packages/shared with common TypeScript types - create package.json, tsconfig.json, src/index.ts, src/types/user.ts, src/types/project.ts, src/types/agents.ts, src/types/api.ts with shared interfaces and enums for all 16 AI agents
Run pnpm install to validate workspace resolution, run pnpm build to confirm everything compiles
acceptance_criteria: pnpm install succeeds from repo root with all workspaces resolved
pnpm build succeeds - Next.js compiles, NestJS compiles, packages compile
pnpm lint succeeds with no errors
Prisma schema is valid (prisma format succeeds)
TypeScript strict mode enabled across all packages
All workspace packages can import from packages/shared and packages/database
